board: School Committee Forum on the 2025 Budget Surplus

cuts.item: positions paid through an entitlement grant

statements.statement: The superintendent said she is really, really concerned about FY27 for the schools.
A speaker said the out-of-district placement expense line item in the operating budget is around $2 million and is expected to continue in future budgets.
The chair said the town is going to need to do an override.
A resident said the town is going to have to go for an override.
A resident said he would not support an override in town given his concerns about school policy.
